Two independent statements inside the filing say so — it opens 「项目位于樟树市、丰城市境内」 (the project lies within Zhangshu City and FENGCHENG City, naming no third county) and the length split allots 12.7 km of 20.2 km to 丰城市. The other seven location columns are corroborated unchanged and stay on the ref record.
